wiki.title: Victoria Sullivan
wiki.extract: Victoria L. Sullivan (born June 21, 1968) is an American politician in the state of New Hampshire. She is currently serving in the New Hampshire State Senate, representing the 18th district. Prior to serving in the Senate, she was a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives, sitting as a Republican from the Hillsborough 16th district, having been first elected in 2014. She lost her reelection bid in 2018 to Democrats Barbara Shaw and Joshua Query.
